description: Two small spiral notebooks on Japan; two small spiral notebooks on Korea; 2 maps of Seoul; eight postcards [three have notes]; two brochures and two entry ticket stubs to temples; typed meditation chant; note pad of notes, bank receipt, and "Ford's Freighter Travel Guide" order form; Travel agent's list of steam ship lines; "The Kounovsky Secret of Lifetime Fitness"; two mimeographed essays by Paul Schmidt, UNM philosophy professor, inspired by the 1972 trip.
title: Japan and Korea trip
